name: Implement Prompt Input Validation and Filtering
description: Apply input validation rules, character filtering, length limits, and prompt injection detection to all user-supplied prompts before they reach the model.

name: Deploy Output Sanitization and PII Redaction
description: Scan and filter model outputs for sensitive information, PII, credentials, and harmful content before delivering to users or downstream systems.

name: Enforce Least-Privilege Access Controls on AI Components
description: Apply RBAC and least-privilege principles to all AI agent tool connectors, plugins, data source access, and model endpoints.

frameworkRefs.name: Protect - Identity Management and Access Control

name: Require Human Approval for Consequential Agent Actions
description: Configure AI agents to require human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact actions such as data writes, external API calls, financial operations, and permission changes.

name: Apply Rate Limiting and Query Throttling
description: Enforce rate limits, request quotas, and query complexity limits on model inference endpoints to prevent DoS attacks and systematic model extraction.

name: Classify and Control Data Sent to AI Systems
description: Implement data classification tagging on all flows to AI components. Block or mask confidential and restricted data before sending to external model providers.

name: Validate Training Data Provenance and Integrity
description: Verify the source, integrity, and quality of all training and fine-tuning datasets. Scan for poisoned samples, adversarial examples, and data quality issues.

name: Verify Model Supply Chain Integrity
description: Verify model provenance, check cryptographic signatures, and validate model checksums before deployment. Maintain a model SBOM and scan dependencies for vulnerabilities.

name: Encrypt All Data Flows to and from AI Components
description: Ensure TLS 1.2+ encryption on all data flows carrying prompts, model outputs, embeddings, and training data, especially those crossing trust boundaries.

name: Deploy Guardrails on Model Input and Output
description: Deploy dedicated guardrail components or moderation layers that inspect and filter both inputs to and outputs from LLMs for policy violations, injection patterns, and harmful content.

name: Enable Continuous Monitoring and Anomaly Detection
description: Deploy monitoring for model inference patterns, output quality drift, unusual query volumes, and potential adversarial probing. Set up alerts for anomalous behavior.

name: Implement Data Pipeline Validation for Training
description: Add integrity checks, schema validation, and anomaly detection to data ingestion pipelines feeding training and fine-tuning processes.

name: Encode and Validate Model Output Before Downstream Use
description: Treat model output as untrusted. Apply context-appropriate encoding/escaping and validation before passing it to interpreters, executors, query engines, or rendering layers (HTML, SQL, shell, code).

name: Protect and Externalize System Prompts
description: Keep secrets and sensitive logic out of system prompts. Apply prompt-hardening, treat the system prompt as recoverable, and enforce security controls outside the prompt rather than relying on it for confidentiality.

name: Ground and Verify Model Outputs
description: Constrain responses to verified sources, attach citations, apply retrieval grounding, and require human verification for high-stakes outputs to reduce reliance on fabricated or unverified content.
